mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, device_id, plugin_id, codec_id, config_ref, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM device_connector_binding WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_connector_binding(tenant_id, device_id, plugin_id, codec_id, config_ref, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{binding.tenantId}, #{binding.deviceId}, #{binding.pluginId}, #{binding.codecId}, #{binding.configRef}, #{binding.status}, #{binding.version}, #{binding.createdAt}, #{binding.updatedAt})
